description: This PHP script defines a client for creating test cases via an API, specifically for the TestLink project. It constructs API call arguments, initializes a client, and executes a request to create a test case, including test case details and steps.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class for making XML-RPC calls to the server to perform various API operations.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes an XML-RPC call with specified method and arguments, returning the server's response.
